description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'NotesSidebar' that displays a sidebar with annotations/notes for the current chapter of a book, including UI elements for viewing, selecting, and adding notes. It interacts with application state through provider states, renders UI components based on the state, and includes user interaction handlers for note selection and addition.
